recent_posts.title: What Can Go Wrong When an Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) Instance is Exposed to SSRF
recent_posts.summary: Exposing an Amazon EC2 instance to SSRF can allow attackers to trigger calls to AWS services from within the instance, leveraging exfiltrated credentials. Mitigation requires detection and removal of the issue or preventing the triggering of such calls.

recent_posts.title: Building Custom Scenarios with CNAPPgoat
recent_posts.summary: Building Custom Scenarios with CNAPPgoat is built with Pulumi, an open-source platform that lets developers use familiar programming languages to define and deploy cloud infrastructure. It works with multiple cloud providers and provides a simple programming model. This means you can write scenarios in your preferred language - be it Go, Python or YAML.

recent_posts.title: The MGM Breach and the Role of IdP in Modern Cyber Attacks
recent_posts.summary: The MGM Breach and the Role of IdP in Modern Cyber Attacks are a deep dive into the recent MGM breach and our insights into the actor behind the attack and possible mitigations. This blog post was co-authored by Igal Gofman, Liv Matan, Noam Dahan, and Ari Eitan.

recent_posts.title: What’s New with CNAPPgoat?
recent_posts.summary: CNAPPgoat is Ermetic’s open-source contribution to the multicloud environment landscape. It is a vulnerable-by-design deployment tool tailored for defenders and pentesters. By allowing intentional vulnerabilities to be seeded across AWS, Azure and GCP, we aim to provide a realistic setting for practitioners.

recent_posts.title: The Azure Metadata Protection You Didn’t Know Was There
recent_posts.summary: The Azure Metadata Protection You Didn't Know Was There was co-authored by Lior Zatlavi and Liv Matan. This protection strengthens the rationale for avoiding sending VMs to do a managed service job. The metadata service holds and serves session tokens for a proxy identity that has privileges to access resources in the cloud environment.

recent_posts.title: Stronger Together: Writing a New Chapter in Cloud Security
recent_posts.summary: Tenable has announced intent to acquire Ermetic. Tenable One and Ermetic will deliver comprehensive context beyond the public cloud. It takes a strong team and a strong organization to tackle these challenges and build a solution that customers can rely on in the long term.

recent_posts.title: Cloud Entitlement Security and Benefits
recent_posts.summary: Cloud identities and entitlements pose grave challenges in the public cloud. The challenges to confronting cloud IAM security are many: Lack of visibility into identities, resources and permissions. The shortage of know-how in cloud identity management across clouds and how to remediate findings is a common pain point.

recent_posts.title: The Next Step in the IMDSv1 Redemption Journey
recent_posts.summary: Learn about AWS’s new open source library for enforcing IMDSv2 and Ermetic's new lab for trying it out. The library can be installed on an EC2 instance; it detects calls made to IMDSV1, logs with which API version they were made and at what time.

recent_posts.title: CNAPPgoat: The Multicloud Open-Source Tool for Deploying Vulnerable-by-Design Cloud Resources
recent_posts.summary: CNAPPgoat is a multicloud open-source tool for deploying vulnerable-by-design cloud resources. It is intended to reinvent the creation of vulnerable cloud infrastructure for a variety of purposes. It includes atomic, (and down the line - more complex) vulnerable scenarios that together will provide as much coverage as possible.

recent_posts.title: Do I Need CNAPP If We’re Only Starting to Deploy to the Cloud?
recent_posts.summary: Cloud security is an ongoing, dynamic, multi-layered acrobatic act. Studies report ballooning misconfigurations and vulnerabilities, and excessive entitlements, for all organizations no matter how small their cloud footprint is. When cloud resources are not configured correctly, the cloud environment is vulnerable.

top_posts.title: A New Incentive for Using AWS VPC Endpoints
top_posts.summary: A new Incentive for Using AWS VPC Endpoints - Ermetic A New Incentives for Using Amazon VPC endpoints. The new condition keys allow for the creation of a data perimeter that is a perfect fit for minimizing the impact of the exfiltration of credentials from EC2 instances.

top_posts.title: IAM Role Trust Update
top_posts.summary: AWS announced they are changing an aspect of how trust policy is evaluated when it comes to assuming roles. In the past, IAM roles implicitly trusted themselves; that is, they could assume themselves if they had an IAM (identity-based) policy attached to it.

top_posts.title: A Letter from the CEO
top_posts.summary: Ermetic emerged as a pioneer in Cloud Infrastructure Entitlements Management ( CIEM) in 2019. We were one of the first to recognize identities as the greatest risk in the cloud, and built our company to secure the new perimeter. More than 75% of cloud breaches result from cloud identity misconfigurations.

top_posts.title: Why It’s Important to Take Notice of AWS IAM Roles Anywhere
top_posts.summary: AWS released IAM Roles Anywhere to extend the usage of IAM roles to hybrid (on-prem and AWS) environments that require access to AWS resources and don’t otherwise have an identity that can be federated to an AWS account. The way it works is by creating a trust anchor with a Certificate Authority.
